sources.title: Cupul
sources.note: Infobox established 1441, disestablished 1543, capital Saki; Ek Balam 1440; seventeen Kuchkabals by 1461; a stub.

notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. CUPUL. The page is a stub with an infobox; 1441 and 1543 are its infobox. The 1546 uprising of 'an alliance of eastern provinces' (conquest page) post-dates the infobox end; Cupul's Montejo contact in 1529 is on the Can Pech page ('By 1529, when he reached Cupul').
